verdict.rationale: Alloy documents outbound webhooks that fire on asynchronous events such as manual reviews, with signed payloads and retry logic. Its monitoring workflows generate investigations. Together these could push review decisions to an external system, but nothing documents syncing investigations or cases with another case-management system, and nothing shows a two-way flow. Missing for 10: a documented investigation/case sync or export API, inbound updates from an external case system, a mapping between Alloy investigations and external case IDs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can synchronize investigations and decisions with another case-management system
